blocks.heading: Twelve worth explaining, within the full list of 45
blocks.intro: INCI order reflects descending proportion. That is why niacinamide's position matters more than the fact that it is present at all.
blocks.caption: Full INCI list as published by the manufacturer: Aqua, Sodium Polyacrylate, C13-14 Isoalkane, Laureth-7, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Sodium Palmitoyl Proline, Nymphaea Alba Flower Extract, Dicaprylyl Ether, Safflower Seed Oil Piperonyl Esters, Propanediol, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Glyceryl Stearate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Xylitylglucoside, Anhydroxylitol, Xylitol, Cyclopentasiloxane, Calophyllum Inophyllum Seed Oil, Sea Water, Lactobacillus Ferment, Curcuma Longa Root Extract, Helichrysum Italicum Extract, Titanium Dioxide, Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid, Asiatic Acid, Ceteareth-20, Ceteareth-12, Cetyl Palmitate, Physalis Angulata Extract, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Zinc Oxide, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Butylene Glycol, Polysorbate 80, 1,2-Hexanediol, Citric Acid, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Aluminium Hydroxide, Silica, Lecithin, Disodium EDTA, CI 42090. — The table below explains the most notable ingredients, not the entire list.

rows.name: Niacinamide
rows.role: Supports the skin barrier and evenness of tone. Fifth on the INCI list.

rows.name: Asiaticoside, madecassic acid, asiatic acid
rows.role: The three main centella actives, named individually rather than lumped into “centella extract”.
rows.suitedFor: Easily flushed or recently treated skin

rows.name: Nymphaea alba flower extract
rows.role: White water lily extract, used among calming ingredients.

rows.name: Xylitylglucoside, anhydroxylitol, xylitol
rows.role: A xylitol-based humectant trio that usually appears together.

rows.name: Lactobacillus ferment
rows.role: Fermented ingredient, related to the skin surface microbiome.

rows.name: Helichrysum italicum extract
rows.role: Immortelle extract, used among calming ingredients.

rows.name: Dipotassium glycyrrhizate
rows.role: Liquorice derivative, a common calming ingredient.

rows.name: Calophyllum inophyllum seed oil
rows.role: Tamanu oil, a regional conditioning ingredient.

rows.name: Titanium dioxide, zinc oxide
rows.role: Two light-reflecting minerals. Present in small amounts in a moisturiser here and NOT a substitute for sunscreen.

rows.name: Sea water
rows.role: Seawater, a mineral source in the formula.

rows.name: Physalis angulata extract
rows.role: Cutleaf groundcherry extract, a conditioning ingredient.

items.a: {{price}} for the 30g bottle. Free delivery, pay on delivery.

items.q: Does the titanium dioxide and zinc oxide make it a sunscreen?
items.a: No. Those minerals act as physical filters at high concentration in a formula designed and tested for an SPF figure. Here they sit near the end of the INCI list in small amounts. You still need a separate sunscreen in the morning.

items.q: Why is this the only product with a full INCI list?
items.a: It is what we would like to see for every product. At present the manufacturer publishes the complete list only for this one; for the others this site prints exactly what is on the packaging and does not fill in the rest.
Keep away from heat and direct sunlight, close after use, keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with the eyes.
